nodes.text: Brendan turns to Taylor...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Happy New...
...But Taylor is headed for the front door.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Year?
As the rest of the nerds whoop and holler for the New Year, Brendan stops Taylor...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Taylor, wait! Where are you going?
Taylor turns to face him...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: This party is exactly what I didn't want to go to!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I know it hasn't gone perfectly!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It's been a total disaster!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I just wanted you to feel like we cared!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah, well, instead I feel like I don't belong!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Goodbye, Brendan!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Where are you going?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Jessica's party! I'm going to grovel my way back onto the cheer team!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'll serve Jessica, but at least I'll be popular again!
Taylor storms off... Brendan trudges back to the nerds...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: She's gone...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Well, at least I still have you guys...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Ha! Look at this nerd! He's all sad 'cause he doesn't have a girl to kiss!

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: That is `so` funny! My nerd alert is going to run out of batteries!
nodes.text_bbcode: That is [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] funny! My nerd alert is going to run out of batteries!

nodes.text: Ashley hops to the side a few feet...

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Heh. Nerd alert. Bweeooop!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: You guys... That isn't funny... It's mean.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: I tend to agree with Brendan here...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Thanks, Andrew.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Andrew? Who's Andrew?! You must be talking about Chaz Wentworth!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: What happened? Why are you guys still in character?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: We decided it was too much fun to L.A.R.P. as cool people than to actually `be` nerds.
nodes.text_bbcode: We decided it was too much fun to L.A.R.P. as cool people than to actually [color=#e23b3b][i]be[/i][/color] nerds.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: But what about Ogres 'N' Elves?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Ha! More like `No`gres 'N'... `Not` Elves!
nodes.text_bbcode: Ha! More like [color=#e23b3b][i]No[/i][/color]gres 'N'... [color=#e23b3b][i]Not[/i][/color] Elves!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: That isn't even clever!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: I think we're done with nerd games, Brendan.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Wait... We?
Dex extends an oatmeal cookie to Brendan...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Say it ain't so, Dex...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: The name is $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Urrb...
No more Taylor?! No more Ogres 'N' Elves?! This can't be what Brendan wanted for his New Year's party!
Oh, well. The nerd party didn't go well...
`Happy New Year!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]Happy New Year![/b]

nodes.text: Everyone hugs in front of the T.V!
Brendan gives Taylor a quick kiss.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Happy New Year, Taylor!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Awww... Thanks, Brendan...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Could I talk to you outside?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Sure...
As the nerds celebrate, Taylor takes Brendan by the hand and leads him outside...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: What is it?
When Taylor turns around, her eyes are filled with tears...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: What is it? What's wrong? Are you... Are you breaking up with me?
Taylor shakes her head.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Tonight...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Was the best New Year's Party I've ever been to!
Taylor throws herself into Brendan's arms!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You did all this for me, and... And...
Taylor wipes away her tears...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: No one's ever been this nice to me! It's a lot for a mean girl to handle!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: You'd better get used to it...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: And I hate to break it to you... But you're not a mean girl anymore.
Brendan pulls Taylor close and kisses her!
After a long while, Taylor pulls away...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What am I then? If I'm not a mean girl?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: One of us... Sort of...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Is there an initiation ceremony or something?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I'm sure there is. We could get Erik to yell at you as Jessica...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Pass. I think that might be too traumatic.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yeah, you just went through all that drama with her...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I meant that it'd be too traumatic for `Erik.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I meant that it'd be too traumatic for [color=#3b78e2][i]Erik.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Heh. Poor guy. I think acting as Jessica any longer would put him into a pimple coma...
A firework goes off in the distance...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I... I love you, Brendan.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I love you too...
They stay there in each other's arms as the first minutes of the New Year pass...
Looks like it's a good start to the year for Brendan and Taylor!
You helped Brendan give Taylor exactly what she wanted... A party to remember!
But that's not the only party going on in Centerscore! Let's check out Jessica's party!
Can you help $ZOE make it to the New Year?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Jessica?!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: What's wrong with that?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Nothing. I'll do it.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What's the prank?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Uh... Oh, I know! Tell her that you're a radio show host and that she's won a `big` prize!
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh... Oh, I know! Tell her that you're a radio show host and that she's won a [color=#e23b3b][i]big[/i][/color] prize!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: But she has to answer trivia questions in order to win!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: When she can't answer them, you call her an idiot and hang up!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Diabolical, Brendan!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ha! I like it!

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Use my phone so she won't recognize the caller ID!
Ashley hands Taylor her phone, and Taylor calls up Jessica...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Hello?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hi! This is, uh, Fun Fiona with 93.7, the only station that rocks every hour of the day!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And you, Jessica Blair, have won a new car!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What? What did you say?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: All you have to do is answer these three trivia questions...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I can't hear you over the sound of all this fun! Who is this again?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh, this is Fun Fiona!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Totes sorry! I'm at a party and...

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Girl flip!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Whooo!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Now I'm upside down! Zach! Put me down, I'm on the phone!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: This is `so` much fun! Gotta go!
nodes.text_bbcode: This is [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] much fun! Gotta go!

nodes.text: Jessica ends the call.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: She couldn't hear me over the noise of her party...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Sorry, Taylor...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: You guys... Look! It's almost midnight!
Erik turns on the TV, and everyone gathers around to watch the countdown to the New Year...
Five...
Four...
Three...
Two...
One...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: In my underwear?!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Scared?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: No! I'll do it!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Wait... What pool?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: There's a community center next door. They always leave the gate to the pool unlocked!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Unless of course, you're scared?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I said I'd do it!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Come on, everyone!
A few minutes later, Taylor pushes open the gate into the community center pool area...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: They don't have any guard dogs, do they, Brendan?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: No... Just a security guard with an itchy trigger finger...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I'm kidding!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Haha! Very funny!
Taylor walks nervously out to the edge of the pool and strips down to her underwear.
Brendan covers Erik's eyes.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I've already seen too much!
She dips a toe into the water.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: `Oh my gosh!` It's like ice! I can't do it!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Oh my gosh![/i][/color] It's like ice! I can't do it!

nodes.text: Brendan pushes open the gate and stands out on the edge with Taylor. He starts stripping down to his underwear.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Brendan? What are you doing?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Offering support!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: So are we!
Dex and Erik join Brendan and Taylor!

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Might as well...
Ashley joins them. Soon, everyone is standing at the pool's edge in their underwear!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: On three, we jump!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: One! Two! `Three!`
nodes.text_bbcode: One! Two! [color=#e23b3b][i]Three![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Everyone leaps into the pool!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: `YAAAH! ARCTIC WATER!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]YAAAH! ARCTIC WATER![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: `BRRRR!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]BRRRR![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: `WOOOOOH! SO COLD!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]WOOOOOH! SO COLD![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: `MY TOES ARE FROZEN!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]MY TOES ARE FROZEN![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Twenty minutes later, everyone gets warm in front of the fire in Brendan's house...
Brendan and Taylor share a smile...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Good dare?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Good dare, Brendan. Thanks for jumping in with me...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: This story, I'm afraid, is a complete mess!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: And it's all Brendan's fault!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I was just trying to help!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Well, you couldn't have done any worse! We should be playing Ogres 'N' Elves!
Andrew marches off!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: This really isn't a very cool party...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Taylor...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Maybe I can make it up to you... `Next year!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Maybe I can make it up to you... [color=#e23b3b][i]Next year![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I doubt it...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: No... It's a joke. You know, `next year!`
nodes.text_bbcode: No... It's a joke. You know, [color=#e23b3b][i]next year![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Because... It's about to be next year... Really soon... And...
Taylor flops down onto a couch.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Why would I `want` to be reminded of her death, Brendan?
nodes.text_bbcode: Why would I [color=#e23b3b][i]want[/i][/color] to be reminded of her death, Brendan?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I don't know! I thought that's where you were going!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: That is really dark!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: That's precisely why!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: I always encounter a couple like you two...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: And I'm reminded of the love that she and I had.
Brendan puts his arm around Taylor...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: To be reminded of what?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Stuff?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: I tried to save her on the snowmobile, but I crashed.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: I crawled through mountains of endless snow to reach her, but by the time I got there...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Did she...?
Andrew nods...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: It happened on New Year's, and every New Year's I attend a soiree like this one...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Aww...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: You must come to a party like this to be reminded...

nodes.text: How could I be alive if I lost my heart?

nodes.text: That's gross, Brendan!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Sorry...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: This sucks so much!

nodes.text: Please, allow me to continue my tragic tale...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Fine! Just get to an ending... Quick!

nodes.text: I was talking about the woman I once loved...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: She was `very` special... An extraordinary woman and a tenacious ski instructor!
nodes.text_bbcode: She was [color=#e23b3b][i]very[/i][/color] special... An extraordinary woman and a tenacious ski instructor!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: She was beautiful, and she had the kindest heart of anyone I've ever met...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: We were engaged to be married...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: But something happened?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: I just told you that I lost my leg!

Soon, the doorbell rings!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: All right, everyone, that's Taylor... Get to your places!
The nerds scramble into position. Brendan opens the door for Taylor...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'm here...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Perfect timing! Are you prepared to be transported into the realm of popularity?!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Sure... But this seems lame...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Trust me...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: May I take your coat?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Fine. Here.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: We may not have a bunch of `real` cheerleaders or football players at this party, but we have the next best thing...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Nerds with acting skills!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ugh! I really don't think I can handle Dextrous Shadowguard right now...

nodes.text: No Ogres 'N' Elves here! In fact, there are two 'cheerleaders' right over there!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Where?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Look!

nodes.text: Seriously? That's just goofy Dex and goofier Erik...

nodes.text: Silence! I'm Jessica! I'm insane with power! $ZOE, make a pyramid all by yourself!

nodes.text: Are you trying to tempt me off my diet?! Just for that you have to wash my car and... Uh... Buy me shoes!

nodes.text: Oh, and here's my very good friend, Howard!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: The name's Chaz. Chaz Wentworth.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Uh-oh... Andrew's ad-libbing! I'd better pay attention if I'm going to keep this charade up!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Right, how could I not recognize you, Mr...

nodes.text: Taylor?! What about us?

nodes.text: It does beg the question... Why make one girl happy at the inconvenience of many?

nodes.text: Except this year, I'm not cheer captain... Jessica is.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Huh. I don't think anyone here has ever even `heard` of that party!
nodes.text_bbcode: Huh. I don't think anyone here has ever even [color=#e23b3b][i]heard[/i][/color] of that party!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, no offense, Brendan, but the people at your party are all nobodies.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: None taken...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Look, never tell anyone I said this... I have fun playing Ogres 'N' Elves.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But New Year's is the time for a `real` party! I just don't think I'll be happy playing nerd games...
nodes.text_bbcode: But New Year's is the time for a [color=#3b78e2][i]real[/i][/color] party! I just don't think I'll be happy playing nerd games...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Not while I'm thinking about how much fun everyone's having at Jessica's party!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Well... What if I told you we're `not playing` Ogres 'N' Elves tonight?
nodes.text_bbcode: Well... What if I told you we're [color=#e23b3b][i]not playing[/i][/color] Ogres 'N' Elves tonight?

nodes.text: The nerds gasp!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Sacrilege!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: What are we supposed to do on New Year's? Socialize?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Socializing gives me goose pimples!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Shh!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I don't know, Brendan...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: In fact, I just had a great idea! Come over here in thirty minutes! Trust me.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Okay... I'll be there... But it better not be for something lame!
Taylor hangs up.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Did I hear you right? Did you say we're `not playing` Ogres 'N' Elves?
nodes.text_bbcode: Did I hear you right? Did you say we're [color=#e23b3b][i]not playing[/i][/color] Ogres 'N' Elves?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: That's correct! Instead, we're going to throw Taylor a `cool` party...
nodes.text_bbcode: That's correct! Instead, we're going to throw Taylor a [color=#e23b3b][i]cool[/i][/color] party...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: We'll act just like the popular kids!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Ahhh! Now my goose pimples have goose pimples! It's a pimple tower!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: But Ogres 'N' Elves is tradition!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Last night, `at three a.m.` I was crafting a perfect story arc with a complicated five-act structure!
nodes.text_bbcode: Last night, [color=#e23b3b][i]at three a.m.[/i][/color] I was crafting a perfect story arc with a complicated five-act structure!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Guys, please? It will...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: The 'old Taylor'?! What's that supposed to mean?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Uh... You know, now you're the improved Taylor. Taylor 2.0.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Stop referring to me like I'm a software upgrade!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Sorry...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Forget it.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Remember? You're trying to be a better, more well-rounded person!

nodes.text: Ugh, it's so annoying when you say that!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Why?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Because it works!

nodes.text: Now come on... Tell me what's really going on.

nodes.text: How's it coming, guys?

nodes.text: Excellent! We're ready to quest into 2012! The map of Ogres 'N' Elves is laid out, the twenty-sided dice are all polished...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: ...And thanks to Erik, we shouldn't have any trouble with pesky breaks for `meals!`

nodes.text_bbcode: I made raisin-[color=#e23b3b][i]ogre[/i][/color]meal cookies! They're the perfect snack!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: But don't worry... They only `sort of` taste like ogres!
nodes.text_bbcode: But don't worry... They only [color=#e23b3b][i]sort of[/i][/color] taste like ogres!

nodes.text: You adventurers are in for the most epic questing of your lives! I was up all night conceptualizing the perfect story...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Ashley, you're going to play with us tonight, right?

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Uh, I don't know... I'll probably just watch... I'm not really into Ogres 'N' Elves...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: That's okay. Just as long as you have fun doing... Whatever it is you do.

nodes.text: Is Taylor coming?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yeah... Actually, she should be here by now...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Hello?

nodes.text: Are you on the way?

nodes.text: What's wrong?

nodes.text: I'm... I'm sorry. I don't really want to go to your party...

nodes.text: What? Why not?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I don't want to hang out with your nerdy friends, okay?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Come on...

nodes.text: It's almost New Year's, everybody! Grab your partner and go to the edge of the park to see the fireworks over the city!

nodes.speaker: Jessica

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Good! Then get out! In fact, I'll take you out myself...

nodes.text: Hey... Ryan. What are you doing here?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Why does everyone ask me that?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Jessica `invited` me. Why did she do it? Who knows? Who cares?
nodes.text_bbcode: Jessica [color=#e23b3b][i]invited[/i][/color] me. Why did she do it? Who knows? Who cares?

nodes.text_bbcode: What is [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] supposed to mean?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Well, it's been a long time since a girl has checked up on me.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Okay... You know what happens at midnight, right?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It turns into the New Year, full of the hope and promise of the future?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: No, it turns into the hour you get to make out with whoever you want!

nodes.text: That's not... Technically accurate...

nodes.text: I've been having a hard time, $ZOE. You know I broke up with Robot Girlfriend again...

nodes.text: You broke up twice?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Megan tried to revive her, but she shorted out after two dates!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Ever since then, I've had some problems scoring girls.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: No matter how many gifts or compliments I try to give, none of them fall for it! I'm cursed!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: If I don't kiss a girl at midnight, I won't get to kiss anyone all year!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ryan, that's ridiculous...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Is it? Last New Year's, I didn't kiss anyone, and the entire school year, I haven't had any action at all!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What about your Robot Girlfriend?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Ever tried making out with a robot?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No... Unless you count this one weird dream I had...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: It's impossible without getting your tongue fried a few times!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ewww...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: I don't know what to do!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I think I can help.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: `You're` going to make out with me?
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]You're[/i][/color] going to make out with me?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No! We're just going to `talk.`
nodes.text_bbcode: No! We're just going to [color=#3b78e2][i]talk.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Awwww...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay, when you talk to girls, what do you say exactly?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: I say, 'Hey, want to make out?'

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: ...That's pretty much it.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Sometimes I say 'tongue wrestle', sometimes I say 'swap spit'. Once I offered to give a girl a tonsillectomy, that didn't go well...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Now I see the problem. Maybe you should try something new like...
$ZOE manages to restrain herself.

nodes.text: Are you sure you're okay?

nodes.speaker: Zoe

nodes.speaker: Matteo

nodes.speaker: Hannah

nodes.text: I know a few places we could motor to...

nodes.speaker: Zoe

$ZOE controls herself.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No! I'll just stand here and relax...

nodes.speaker: Zoe

nodes.speaker: Zoe

nodes.text: Whew! I'm glad I didn't go over there!

Howard comes over to her, bringing Sam.

nodes.speaker: Zoe

$ZOE sighs.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm starting to wish we just had a quiet, uneventful night in...

nodes.text: Hey $ZOE...

nodes.text: Uh oh! I'd better say the right thing. Ben would actually know what I'm talking about...
$ZOE offers the plate out to him.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What's the phrase for 'Take that' again?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Ugh... Okay... Whatever.
Hannah and Zach walk away.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Wrong! Wrong! Wrong!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You're supposed to say `Jeausych!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You're supposed to say [color=#3b78e2][i]Jeausych![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Uh... Okay... Whatever.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That means 'thank you'!
Hannah and Zach walk away.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Great!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Ugh... Okay... Whatever.
Hannah and Zach walk away.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What are you doing? That was just gibberish!
Later, Howard and $ZOE arrive at the park near Jessica's house for her party.
As $ZOE puts her cupcakes on the snack table...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Did Jessica ever tell you why you had to wear the elf costume?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No... I don't even know why I listened to her. She didn't make anyone else dress up!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Amanda's wearing the same costume.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I'm an elf!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Great...
Suddenly Jessica comes up and grabs $ZOE's arm.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Sorry, Howard. I need to talk to $ZOE and Amanda for a second.
Jessica takes $ZOE over to Amanda and brings them aside.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I've asked you two to come dressed up for a very special purpose...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Is the Easter Bunny coming? Are we going to help him have his babies?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: No. Also weird.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Rabbit babies have little feet!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ahem. You're going to be servers! You're going to serve snacks to the guests!
Jessica pushes dessert trays into Amanda and $ZOE's hands.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yay!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Before you go associating with anybody, you have to know two very important things!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: 'A' is for Amanda!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: `No`.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]No[/i][/color].

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You two have to speak Elvish.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Is that anything like Spanish? Spanish gives me a rash...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Jessica, are you serious?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Of course I am!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Jessica, how do you even `know` Elvish?
nodes.text_bbcode: Jessica, how do you even [color=#3b78e2][i]know[/i][/color] Elvish?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I hired Andrew to pronounce everything for me in exchange for listening to one of his stupid bard songs.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It's worse than listening to house music!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: But back to my point... Elvish. You speak it. When you're circling around, offering the tray, you say `Tvurulo.` That means 'Take that!'
nodes.text_bbcode: But back to my point... Elvish. You speak it. When you're circling around, offering the tray, you say [color=#3b78e2][i]Tvurulo.[/i][/color] That means 'Take that!'

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And when people take food from you, say `Jeausych.` That means 'Thank you.'
nodes.text_bbcode: And when people take food from you, say [color=#3b78e2][i]Jeausych.[/i][/color] That means 'Thank you.'

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Got that?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sure...
At that moment, Hannah and Zach come near...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: This night would be so much better if Colt were here...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: I'd totally make out with that guy on his motorcycle!
Jessica makes a motion for $ZOE to serve them. $ZOE offers her plate out.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... Tvurulo cookie?

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: There are cookies at this party! This party rocks!
Hannah and Zach take cookies off the tray.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: But too bad these cookies suck! No one likes raisins!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I do...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: `Ahem.` Aren't you going to say anything, $ZOE?
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Ahem.[/i][/color] Aren't you going to say anything, $ZOE?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: How do you say 'Thank you' again?!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: A prank? What kind of prank?

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: We love pranks!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: What do you do with the confetti? Are you going to dump glue on someone's head and then fan confetti on them?

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: We call that the 'disco ball'!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No! That's not the plan at all!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Or are you going to stuff the confetti in their car's air vents and put the air on full blast?

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: We call that the 'snow storm'!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No! Where are you coming up with this stuff?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We're just going to cut stars out and put them in a bag.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: That sounds so unfun! In `what way` is that a prank?
nodes.text_bbcode: That sounds so unfun! In [color=#3b78e2][i]what way[/i][/color] is that a prank?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Now it just sounds like work again! And I don't want to do work!
The twins get up and run around.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: I want more cupcakes!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Not more work!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'll just have to do this all by myself.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I can help you...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks, Howard...
A few hours later...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard, I've only done a few hundred pieces... How are you doing?
No answer.
$ZOE looks over to see Howard, slumped over, napping on a small pile of confetti.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I guess I'll take over the rest.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: There goes that nap I wanted to take before the party...
As the day wears on, $ZOE cuts out more and more stars...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Stupid... Five-pointed... Stars...
Until finally...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Done! Done! Done!
$ZOE packs everything up and wakes Howard.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Huh? What happened? How many more stars do we need?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I finished it up, Howard. We're done. Now I'm going home to change.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Okay. I'll pick you up at 8.
$ZOE packs up and leaves.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm exhausted! But tonight's the real challenge. How am I ever going to survive Jessica's New Year's party?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The game is whoever makes the most star confetti wins!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: I bet I can make way more than Kel!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: I bet I can make a ton more than Kay!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: And we can both make a bajillion more than Howard!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's the way to think about it!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Hey, do we get something after we've cut everything out?

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Yeah, if we help you, what do we win?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The most awesome thing in the world! A sense of accomplishment!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Boo!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Just kidding! I promise you I'll make you something extra nice.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: What's extra nice?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: A cookie in the shape of your faces!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Yay!
A couple hours later... $ZOE, Howard, and the twins finish all the confetti!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I never want to see another star again!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah really!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Who won?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I think we all did! I'll bake your cookies next weekend, okay?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Right now... I have to go home... And take a nap so I can survive tonight!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Bye bye, $ZOE!
$ZOE packs up all her things and heads out.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm all ready for this party! I can do this!

nodes.title: The Popular Party
nodes.subtitle: How the other half lives it up!

nodes.text: How the other half lives it up!

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Whew! I just finished hand-frosting all the cupcakes... They all have fireworks frosting for New Year's!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: How do they taste?
Howard takes one of them, inspects it, and shoves it in his mouth.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Mmmrph!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Delicious, right? And after this last batch of cookies, I'll be all ready for tonight.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Jessica's making you doing an awful lot for her party.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, she didn't ask me to do this... I decided to do it on my own.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Why?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ever since Jessica used me to become Head Cheerleader, no one likes me. I have to try to be nicer than ever now!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE, you `are` nice. Just be yourself, and people will figure it out.
nodes.text_bbcode: $ZOE, you [color=#e23b3b][i]are[/i][/color] nice. Just be yourself, and people will figure it out.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks, Howard. But it's not that easy... I just don't know how I'm going to survive a new year like this...
At that moment, $ZOE's phone rings...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hello?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: $ZOE, I have a few last minute party things that need to be taken care of...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sure, Jessica! What do you need me to do?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: The theme of the party changed. Remember all that confetti I made you get?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You had me cut all the letters in your name out of shiny paper. Two hundred times. By hand! I never want to see another 'S' again!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Good! That means you can toss all that crap out! We need stars! I need you to cut stars by hand!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But that'll take me all day!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Sounds great!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Oh! Also I need you to dress up as an elf...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: An elf! With the little hat and everything! Got that? See you tonight, Confetti Elf Girl!
Jessica hangs up, and $ZOE stares into the phone.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Don't worry, $ZOE. I can help you with whatever she's tasked you with.
Kay and Kel scamper into the kitchen.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: $ZOE! Do you have cupcakes for us?! We've been real good!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: We haven't stolen anything from Howard all day!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's only nine in the morning.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: I said what I said.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, I guess I can reward you two for that. One each.
The twins eat their cupcakes happily. $ZOE looks from her roll of shiny confetti paper to the twins.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, twins... What are you doing today?

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Nothing. Why?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: One of my friends wants me to make confetti by cutting stars out of shiny paper, and you two look like just the girls to help me!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What do you say? It's something we can all do together!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: I don't know... That sounds like work...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's not work...

nodes.text: The doorbell rings...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Those must be the special guests!
Brendan opens the door to reveal $Scott and Angie!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Look who it is, Taylor! It's $Scott and...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I'm Amanda! Yay, cookies! Yay, everyone!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Jeepers! $Scott's here! It's like the Star Tour came to us!
Dex nudges Erik...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I mean... Shoe sale! Totes hot! Way super!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Am I saying anything?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Now that everyone's here, we can finally play the game all cool people play...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Truth or Dare!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What? You guys play that?
The nerds huddle around the table...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Dex... Er... $ZOE, you're first...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: I choose... Truth!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Did you know that the word 'modem' is a contraction of two words?!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: '`Mo`dulate, `dem`odulate!'
nodes.text_bbcode: '[color=#e23b3b][i]Mo[/i][/color]dulate, [color=#e23b3b][i]dem[/i][/color]odulate!'

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Good fact! 'Jessica', you're up?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Truth!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: My mom is an angel! I mean, `Erik's` mom is an angel!
nodes.text_bbcode: My mom is an angel! I mean, [color=#e23b3b][i]Erik's[/i][/color] mom is an angel!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What is wrong with you guys? Do you not know how to play Truth or Dare?!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: How else are you supposed to play?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You guys are the worst! Make room!
Taylor squeezes in next to them.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ashley starts... Not Hannah or Zach... `Ashley...` Truth or Dare?
nodes.text_bbcode: Ashley starts... Not Hannah or Zach... [color=#3b78e2][i]Ashley...[/i][/color] Truth or Dare?

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Truth?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Now I'm going to ask you a question, and you `have` to tell the truth!
nodes.text_bbcode: Now I'm going to ask you a question, and you [color=#3b78e2][i]have[/i][/color] to tell the truth!

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: I do?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: If you and Angie were the last two people on earth, would you make out with her?

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Uh...
Ashley looks around, blushing...

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: I guess I would. Otherwise, I'd never kiss anyone again.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Uhh...
The nerds' jaws all drop!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: This game is awesome!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: All right, Taylor, you're up!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I choose dare!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Uh... I dare you to...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: I haven't seen you around before... Are you into motorcycles? Because you'd look really hot on one...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I don't own a motorcycle, but I do have a motor scooter.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: They both have motors... I don't judge. What are you doing on Friday night?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: I know a few places we could motor to...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Grrrr....
But that's not the only party going on in Centerscore! Let's check out Jessica's party!
Can you help $ZOE make it to the New Year?
`Happy New Year!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]Happy New Year![/b]

nodes.text: Everyone hugs in front of the T.V!
Brendan gives Taylor a quick kiss.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Happy New Year, Taylor!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Awww... Thanks, Brendan...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Could I talk to you outside?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Sure...
As the nerds celebrate, Taylor takes Brendan by the hand and leads him outside...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: What is it?
When Taylor turns around, her eyes are filled with tears...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: What is it? What's wrong? Are you... Are you breaking up with me?
Taylor shakes her head.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Tonight...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Was the best New Year's Party I've ever been to!
Taylor throws herself into Brendan's arms!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You did all this for me, and... And...
Taylor wipes away her tears...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: No one's ever been this nice to me! It's a lot for a mean girl to handle!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: You'd better get used to it...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: And I hate to break it to you... But you're not a mean girl anymore.
Brendan pulls Taylor close and kisses her!
After a long while, Taylor pulls away...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What am I then? If I'm not a mean girl?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: One of us... Sort of...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Is there an initiation ceremony or something?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I'm sure there is. We could get Erik to yell at you as Jessica...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Pass. I think that might be too traumatic.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yeah, you just went through all that drama with her...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I meant that it'd be too traumatic for `Erik.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I meant that it'd be too traumatic for [color=#3b78e2][i]Erik.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Heh. Poor guy. I think acting as Jessica any longer would put him into a pimple coma...
A firework goes off in the distance...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I... I love you, Brendan.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I love you too...
They stay there in each other's arms as the first minutes of the New Year pass...
Looks like it's a good start to the year for Brendan and Taylor!
You helped Brendan give Taylor exactly what she wanted... A party to remember!
$ZOE slips away, to a wooden area by some picnic tables...
Where she finds Ryan, sitting on a rock.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey... Ryan. What are you doing here?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Why does everyone ask me that?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Jessica `invited` me. Why did she do it? Who knows? Who cares?
nodes.text_bbcode: Jessica [color=#e23b3b][i]invited[/i][/color] me. Why did she do it? Who knows? Who cares?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I kind of meant... Why are you all the way out here and not over at the party with everyone else?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: It's kind of crowded back there.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It looks like something else is bothering you. What's wrong?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: I can't tell you. Not after what you did to Jessica.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What is `that` supposed to mean?
nodes.text_bbcode: What is [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] supposed to mean?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: I hear you don't keep secrets very well.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I keep secrets just fine!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I just want to see if you're okay.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Hey... Is that an invitation to make out?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Well, it's been a long time since a girl has checked up on me.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It looks like you need someone to talk to, and I hate to see anyone this miserable.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Okay... You know what happens at midnight, right?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It turns into the New Year, full of the hope and promise of the future?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: No, it turns into the hour you get to make out with whoever you want!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's not... Technically accurate...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: I've been having a hard time, $ZOE. You know I broke up with Robot Girlfriend again...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You broke up twice?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Megan tried to revive her, but she shorted out after two dates!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Ever since then, I've had some problems scoring girls.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: No matter how many gifts or compliments I try to give, none of them fall for it! I'm cursed!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: If I don't kiss a girl at midnight, I won't get to kiss anyone all year!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ryan, that's ridiculous...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Is it? Last New Year's, I didn't kiss anyone, and the entire school year, I haven't had any action at all!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What about your Robot Girlfriend?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Ever tried making out with a robot?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No... Unless you count this one weird dream I had...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: It's impossible without getting your tongue fried a few times!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ewww...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: I don't know what to do!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I think I can help.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: `You're` going to make out with me?
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]You're[/i][/color] going to make out with me?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No! We're just going to `talk.`
nodes.text_bbcode: No! We're just going to [color=#3b78e2][i]talk.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Awwww...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay, when you talk to girls, what do you say exactly?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: I say, 'Hey, want to make out?'

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: ...That's pretty much it.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Sometimes I say 'tongue wrestle', sometimes I say 'swap spit'. Once I offered to give a girl a tonsillectomy, that didn't go well...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Now I see the problem. Maybe you should try something new like...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: If you excuse me, Sam... I just need some air.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But we're outside...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I just need to be away from people right now.
$ZOE is about to rush away when Jessica strides angrily up to them.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Where do you think you're going, $ZOE?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: On a break.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What about the food? And the Elvish?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Geez, Jessica. She'll be back in a minute... Your party will live.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What are you doing `here`, Sam?
nodes.text_bbcode: What are you doing [color=#3b78e2][i]here[/i][/color], Sam?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Talking to the people I love, which you probably have no concept of.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Whatev. Don't you have a pool to jump in?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hot tub, actually. At my own swim team party. I was just dropping by.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Good! Then get out! In fact, I'll take you out myself...
While Sam distracts Jessica, $ZOE slips away from the party to a more quiet space.
$ZOE crosses her arms.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: $ZOE, are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I mean, if one of my exes had a bunch of girls flirting with him, I'd be pretty bothered.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: He's not really my ex, and... Besides, I'm fine. I'm with Howard, remember?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh no, I'm fine. I'm with Howard, remember?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But that doesn't mean you won't get upset...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm `fine.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]fine.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But Matteo `does` look awfully cozy... Maybe I `should` go over there...
nodes.text_bbcode: But Matteo [color=#3b78e2][i]does[/i][/color] look awfully cozy... Maybe I [color=#3b78e2][i]should[/i][/color] go over there...

nodes.text: We hope you had fun at both parties!
Here's hoping your New Year's Eve is every bit as fun as ours were!
Happy New Year!
Ryan goes up to Hannah.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: So... Hannah.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: What do you want, Ryan?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: I, uh... I don't know anything about you, and I want to. Tell me a thing.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: What, you're not going to ask me to make out with you?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Well, not `yet.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, not [color=#e23b3b][i]yet.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Ha ha. Okay... I like music.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Really? You do? I do too. I'm into the band Violent Yogurt Place...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Really?! I `love` their new album!
nodes.text_bbcode: Really?! I [color=#3b78e2][i]love[/i][/color] their new album!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Want to make out... I mean... Want to talk about it?
Ryan shoots $ZOE a large grin as they walk away.

nodes.text: Everyone follows Jessica's direction to a view of the cityscape.
$ZOE frantically looks around for Howard in the crowd.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE, over here!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard!
$ZOE rushes to him, and he holds her close.
They walk down to the edge of the park where a glistening ball sits at the top of the highest building in the city.
When the clock gets closer to midnight, the entire party starts counting down...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Ten... Nine... Eight...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Seven... Six... Five...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Four... Three... Two...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `ONE!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]ONE![/i][/color]

nodes.text: The large silver ball drops, and everyone cheers!
$ZOE's confetti is released into the air, coating everyone in a silvery blanket of stars!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Whee! Silver snow! This is a magical New Year!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Happy New Year, everyone!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Happy New Year!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Happy New Year!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Happy New Year!
All around, people start making toasts with their soda cups while couples kiss.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Happy New Year, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Happy New Year, Howard.
Howard bends down and kisses $ZOE!
They part, and Howard holds her for a while.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: To next year!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: May both the good and bad times be better than last year!
Over Howard's shoulder, $ZOE can see Matteo standing near the door.
He is alone in the midst of kissing couples.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Happy New Year, Matteo...
Matteo slips away into the night.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: All right, enough kissing! More partying!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Look at me! Woo! I'm dancing on a picnic table!
And all the Centerscore students dance through the night...
Way to bring in the New Year! What a great game!
Thanks to you, $ZOE was able to survive Jessica's New Year party and get her New Year's Kiss!
Everyone heads towards the edge of the park.
$ZOE starts to make her way over when Jessica grabs her arm.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Not you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Don't 'what' me! You're an elf! You have a job to do!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And that job doesn't include making out at midnight!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You're seriously going to stop me from kissing Howard at midnight?!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yeah, I am... You can just spend the rest of the evening cleaning up your stupid cupcakes!
Jessica tries to push a tray of cupcakes into $ZOE's hand.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, you know what I have to say to that?!
$ZOE throws one of her cupcakes down!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks for the worst night ever, Jessica!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh wait... I

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, 'Jeasyxs' for the worst night ever, Jessica!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: That's the best you got? `Jeasyxs` isn't even the right word, $ZOE!
nodes.text_bbcode: That's the best you got? [color=#3b78e2][i]Jeasyxs[/i][/color] isn't even the right word, $ZOE!

nodes.text: Suddenly, the ground starts shaking. All the lights in the park and across the neighborhood start flickering!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Whoa!
And suddenly the city buildings start to quaver and shake!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What... What's going on?!
Ben comes running over to help Jessica.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Wait, $ZOE... What did you just say?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: 'Jeasyxs for the worst night ever, Jessica'?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh no...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]RUN!!![/i][/color]

nodes.text: And at another party across the city...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Uh-oh... Something's happening...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Someone must have said the summoning spell...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: `Jeasyxs Forth Worsnight Everjess Ica!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Jeasyxs Forth Worsnight Everjess Ica![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: If that's the summoning spell, why are `you` saying it?!
nodes.text_bbcode: If that's the summoning spell, why are [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] saying it?!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: I'm repeating it. Some layperson who doesn't know the difference between 'Thank you' and 'Summon the Destroyer' must have done it!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: What language makes those two phrases nearly identical?!
Back across town...
A giant chasm has swallowed up the park! From inside, a gigantic lizard crawls out!

nodes.speaker: Jeasyxs
nodes.text: `Behold, Jeasyxs the Destroyer has returned to this mortal plane!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Behold, Jeasyxs the Destroyer has returned to this mortal plane![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Oh my god... It's a humongous `Lyle!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh my god... It's a humongous [color=#3b78e2][i]Lyle![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Gross!!!

nodes.speaker: Jeasyxs
nodes.text: `Enough! For generations, you have oppressed my kind, putting them in cages, scrubbing them with toothbrushes, and eating their tails...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Enough! For generations, you have oppressed my kind, putting them in cages, scrubbing them with toothbrushes, and eating their tails...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jeasyxs
nodes.text: `No more! Today, a new era comes. Jeasyxs the Destroyer will usher in a new reign!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]No more! Today, a new era comes. Jeasyxs the Destroyer will usher in a new reign![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jeasyxs
nodes.text: `Everyone will be struck down, and the world will be made anew with my kind as its sovereign!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Everyone will be struck down, and the world will be made anew with my kind as its sovereign![/i][/color]

nodes.text: The earth rumbles, and the houses and buildings in the city start to collapse.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: It's Lyle's evil twin brother!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: $ZOE, this is all your fault!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You're right! It is! What have I done?!
Jeasyxs strides forward until he comes to Amanda and $ZOE. He pauses in the midst of his destruction to look down upon them.

nodes.speaker: Jeasyxs
nodes.text: `Hello, Amanda. We meet again...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Hello, Amanda. We meet again...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: `Jeasyxs...` Please don't do this...
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Jeasyxs...[/i][/color] Please don't do this...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Are you really going to destroy everyone?

nodes.speaker: Jeasyxs
nodes.text: `Not everyone. I will spare the lives of elves such as yourself.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Not everyone. I will spare the lives of elves such as yourself.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jeasyxs
nodes.text: `Elves are, after all, the serving class of the Lizard Kings!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Elves are, after all, the serving class of the Lizard Kings![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `Nooooooo!!!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Nooooooo!!![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Oh no! $ZOE's going to become a servant to the ruling race of lizards?
Well, that doesn't sound like a very good New Year's at all!
